1. Substring EPS-ownership inference -> STRUCTURED evidence. FIXED (#2075 D2).
   `_PROVENANCE_MARKER_KINDS = ("epm:run-launched", "epm:pod-provisioned")`
   (L159) restricts the ownership scan to provenance marker kinds, and
   `_structured_pod_ref_pattern` (L261) replicates the #1961 grammar verbatim:
   a boundary-safe `pod=<name>` / `pod=<pod_id>` / `pod_id=<pod_id>` token, or
   the note's LEADING token. `_scan_task_references` (L287) applies it to the
   event `note` and requires `ev["kind"]` in the provenance set. A fleet-audit
   dump quoted into an `epm:progress` note is therefore no longer ownership
   evidence — the self-poisoning channel this task named.

2. Creation-age staleness clock. FIXED (#2075 D3). `classify()` (L611) keys
   EXITED staleness on `exited_age = _exited_age_hours(p)` (L628, parsed from
   the RunPod `lastStatusChange` field), and the stale gate at L674 reads
   `exited_age >= max_exited_hours`. `age = _age_hours(p.created_at)` (L627)
   survives ONLY as display plus the RUNNING orphan threshold (L641) and the
   no-port wedge flag (L659) — never the EXITED stale gate. Unknown /
   unparseable exit time routes to `fresh-exited` (fail-toward-KEEP).

3. Kill-approval interlock retained as the enforcement backstop. PRESENT.
   The audit path is report-only (`--notify-stale` recommends; the
   `runpod_api.terminate_pod` approval interlock refuses cron/watcher-context
   terminates); the daily cron was re-armed report-only under #2075 P7.
